space.label: Space
space.hint: Every space has bookmarks of its own. They show in the sidebar's bookmarks view of that space.

of_space.title: Bookmarks in {space}
of_space.hint: Saved addresses of this space, apart from its tabs.

delete.hint: Deleting removes all of them, folders included. It cannot be undone.

pinned.label: Add pinned tabs to bookmarks
pinned.hint: {pinned} Copy keeps them pinned. Move closes them after: they are bookmarks then, and in the archive. Folders come along; smart folders do not.
pinned.none: This space has no pinned tabs.
pinned.none_added: Every pinned tab is a bookmark already
